verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Status Pages give stakeholders visual, real-time updates on incident status 'without context switching to other tools,' and Incident Workflows/Post-Incident Reviews can push structured summaries, all without requiring war-room participation. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms a subscription/notification mechanism for external stakeholders or a dedicated 'structured update' template feature. Missing for 10: explicit subscribe/follow functionality for status pages, dedicated stakeholder-update templates, and independent confirmation that non-responders actually use this instead of joining incident channels.
